agenda_text:
CALL AND NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING

To the Members of the Finance Advisory Committee of the City of Palos Verdes Estates:

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Chair has called a special meeting of the Finance Advisory
Committee called to order at Palos Verdes Golf Club, 3301 Vía Campesina, Palos Verdes Estates,
CA at 6:00 p.m. on Thursday, November 1, 2018. The agenda for the special meeting with the items
of business to be transacted or discussed is set forth below.

Posted by the Office of the City Clerk on October 26, 2018, at 5:00 p.m.

  November 1, 2018
  6:00 P.M.
  Palos Verdes Golf Club
  3301 Via Campesina
  Margate Room
  Palos Verdes Estates

  AGENDA
  OF A SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE FINANCE ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  OF THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA
Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate
alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities
Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request
a disability-related modification or accommodation.

The Finance Advisory Committee welcomes and encourages public participation at the Finance
Advisory Committee meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each
person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to three (3) minutes or as
specified by the Chairperson. Anyone wishing to address the Finance Advisory Committee is
requested to fill out a speaker’s card available at the end of each row in the Chambers. The card
permits the City to identify persons for purposes of Finance Advisory Committee minutes
preparation.

The Finance Advisory Committee, at the direction of the Chairperson with concurrence of the
Committee, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda. Note: Agenda topics may be
continued to future Committee meetings.

 CALL TO ORDER (6:00 PM)

ROLL CALL

  1. Explanation of reason for venue change
  Description: The Chairperson will provide an explanation for the change in meeting
  location and the associated set-up. There will be no action taken on this matter.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

APPROVAL OF ACTION MINUTES

  2. Meeting of September 6, 2018

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items that are NOT
on the agenda. According to State law, no action can be taken by the Finance Advisory
Committee on matters presented under this section. If time is not adequate to hear all
speakers, the remaining speakers will be called upon at the conclusion of the meeting.

OLD BUSINESS

  3. Report-outs of Ad Hoc Committees
  Description: The Ad Hoc Committees will provide updates on the progress and actions
  being taken towards forecast for discussion by the Finance Advisory Committee. There will
  be no action taken on this matter.

  4. Staff update on projects
  Description: Staff will provide an update on its progress in support of the Finance Advisory
  Committee’s work plan relative to completing the quarterly budget reconciliation, asset
  inventory and depreciation schedule, additional OpenGov deployment, GFOA Risk Analysis
  for analyzing reserve level, comprehensive consolidation of long term capital improvements,
  and hiring a part-time budget analyst. There will be no action taken on this matter.

  5. Discussion of next steps and timeline for completing the financial forecast
  Description: The Finance Advisory Committee will discuss and come to a conclusion for
  the next steps and timeline for finishing its 10-year forecast. An action taken on this matter
  will be provided to the City Council.

NEW BUSINESS

  6. Assess and consider the effectiveness of the present venue and format of this working
  meeting, and schedule the next Finance Advisory Committee meeting
  Description: The Finance Advisory Committee will consider the location, format and date
  for its next meeting and discuss the location future working sessions. An action taken on a
  change in venue from the Council Chambers for future meetings will be provided to the City
  Council.

Finance Advisory Committee Action Minutes
July 16, 2018
  Page 1 of 3
 OLD BUSINESS

  3. Cash Flow Statement and Monthly Roll-Forward

  The Committee directed that staff prepare and publish an updated cash flow document to
  reflect the actual time when the City prepays pension (UAL) costs and the insurance (annual
  invoice), and that staff work with the Operations Ad Hoc Committee in the formulation of
  the report before it is presented to the Committee.

  The Committee requested and staff consented to provide the quarterly revenue/expenditure
  reconciliation (budget to actual comparison) to the Operations Ad Hoc Committee for
  review and comment before presenting and publishing the document.

  4. Timetable for Finance Advisory Committee Action Items

  The Committee requested that a member have an opportunity to participate in the interview
  process for the budget analyst either on the interview panel or as an observer.

  The Committee recommends that staff retain a firm to consolidate all the existing
  infrastructure reports into one document and the costs therein be updated to present values.

  The Committee requested that staff separate maintenance and projects within the Capital
  Improvement Fund in a new document for review and use in preparing future budgets and a
  10-year fiscal forecast.

  The Committee requested that staff prepare a list of high priority capital projects that are
  necessary and wishlist capital projects.

  The Committee directed that the timeline for the Asset Inventory be provided to the
  Operations Ad Hoc Committee. The Committee encouraged staff to commence the work and
  staff consented to pushing the vendor to expidite the work.

  5. Confirmation of Timeline and End-of-October Deliverables and
  6. Ad Hoc Committee Reports

  The Committee requested and staff consented to providing the Capital and Equipment Ad
  Hoc Committee with the infrastructure assessment Request for Proposal (RFP) for review
  and comment.

  The Committee requested that staff contact the County Fire Department for data about its
  pension program for inclusion in the evaluation of the City’s future pension obligations.

  The Committee agreed to schedule on the next agenda for consideration the
  recommendations of the Pension Ad Hoc Committee.

  The Committee requested that the Revenue Ad Hoc Committee evaluate the revenue and
  process associated with encouraging liquior licenses, a policy for the use of one-time funds
